question: Please provide the top 10 tree species in New York, using their uppercase Latin names where the Latin name is not empty and including their common names, showing the total number of trees, the counts of alive and dead trees for each year, and the corresponding growth in these counts from 1995 to 2015, then order by the difference in total tree counts between these years.
sql:
WITH c1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as latin_name,
    COUNT(*) as total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Poor', 'Fair', 'Shaft', 'Critical') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Dead', 'Stump') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != '' AND spc_latin NOT IN ('PLANTING SITE', 'UNKNOWN LIVE TREES', 'UNKNOWN DEAD TREES', 'UNKNOWN STUMP', 'STUMP')
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
c2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as latin_name,
    COUNT(*) as total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Dead', 'Stump') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(a.latin_name, b.latin_name) as latin_name,
    COALESCE(a.total_count, 0) as total_1995,
    COALESCE(b.total_count, 0) as total_2015,
    COALESCE(a.alive_count, 0) as alive_1995,
    COALESCE(b.alive_count, 0) as alive_2015,
    COALESCE(a.dead_count, 0) as dead_1995,
    COALESCE(b.dead_count, 0) as dead_2015,
    COALESCE(b.total_count, 0) - COALESCE(a.total_count, 0) as total_growth,
    COALESCE(b.alive_count, 0) - COALESCE(a.alive_count, 0) as alive_growth,
    COALESCE(b.dead_count, 0) - COALESCE(a.dead_count, 0) as dead_growth
  FROM c1995 a
  FULL OUTER JOIN c2015 b ON a.latin_name = b.latin_name
)
SELECT 
  c.latin_name,
  ts.species_common_name as common_name,
  c.total_1995,
  c.total_2015,
  c.alive_1995,
  c.alive_2015,
  c.dead_1995,
  c.dead_2015,
  c.total_growth,
  c.alive_growth,
  c.dead_growth
FROM combined c
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species` ts 
  ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = c.latin_name
ORDER BY c.total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10
